mapper.select: -- Select operation summary report counts. SELECT (SELECT count(1) FROM users u) AS total_user_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM users u WHERE u.status_code = 'ACTIVE') AS active_user_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcements a WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS approved_announcement_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcements a WHERE a.auto_status_code IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSING_SOON') AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL' ) AS open_announcement_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.status_code = 'MATCHED' ) AS matched_case_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.status_code = 'PROGRESSED' ) AS progressed_case_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.status_code IN ('READY', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'WAITING_RESULT', 'SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED') ) AS active_progress_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'STOPPED', 'COMPLETED') ) AS completed_progress_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM user_subscriptions us WHERE us.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ) AS active_subscription_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM payment_transactions pt WHERE pt.status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS approved_payment_count, ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(pt.amount), 0) FROM payment_transactions pt WHERE pt.status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS approved_payment_amount, ( SELECT count(1) FROM operation_tasks ot WHERE ot.status_code IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'WAITING') ) AS open_operation_task_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM notification_messages nm WHERE nm.read_at IS NULL ) AS unread_notification_count
mapper.insert: -- Insert completed admin report export. INSERT INTO report_exports ( id, report_type_code, format_code, status_code, requested_by, row_count, file_name, content_text, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{exportId}, #{reportTypeCode}, #{formatCode}, #{statusCode}, #{requestedBy}, #{rowCount}, #{fileName}, #{contentText}, CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'COMPLETED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END )
mapper.select: -- Select one report export. SELECT re.id AS export_id, re.report_type_code, re.format_code, re.status_code, re.requested_by, re.row_count, re.file_name, re.content_text, re.requested_at, re.completed_at, re.failure_code, re.failure_message FROM report_exports re WHERE re.id = #{exportId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII admin report snapshot. INSERT INTO admin_report_snapshots ( id, snapshot_type_code, snapshot_json, created_by ) VALUES ( #{snapshotId}, #{snapshotTypeCode}, CAST(#{snapshotJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{actorUserId} )

-- Insert non-PII report audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
